title: POSCO Reaches Revised Tentative Wage Deal
dek: POSCO has reached a revised tentative wage agreement, according to a headline in 조선일보 (Chosun Ilbo).
summary: According to a headline in 조선일보 (Chosun Ilbo), POSCO has reached a revised tentative wage deal. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the terms, the union involved and the ratification timetable are not given.
keyFacts: POSCO has reached a revised tentative wage deal
whyItMatters: Labour stability at South Korea's largest steelmaker matters for regional supply. A tentative deal could reduce the risk of industrial action at its works.
implications: Buyers of Korean flat steel may take some comfort from reduced disruption risk. Readers should watch whether union members ratify the revised terms.
